summary_1line: Dhritarashtra asks about the Pandavas; Sanjaya faints in the court, then recovers and recounts the power and allies of Yudhishthira and Bhima.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the Kuru royal hall, Sanjaya suddenly collapses to the floor before the assembled kings while Vidura rises and announces his fainting.
Crowds of Panchalas, Kekayas, Matsyas, and villagers gather joyfully around the armored Arjuna as Yudhishthira stands calmly restraining eager warriors.
Recovered, Sanjaya stands before blind Dhritarashtra and describes the immense strength of Bhima, whose arms hold the power of ten thousand elephants.
